text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho has arrived. If
Mayano
Top Gun can get through this,
then...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gimme the power to win here! I have to
get to the
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Bingo! It is I, Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But forget that! I have to tell you
something,
Mayano! It's a special
message from Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. "Mayano! Ever since this spring,
you have
been my..." blah, blah, blah...
We can skip this
part.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! The important part comes right
at the
end!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how much you've
improved.
After today, consider us rivals.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Word for word! I totally get what she
means. I
wanna face off against you too,
y'know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So you can't lose! Ya gotta win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Get to the top and leave everyone else
in the
dust!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haha! So you're telling me to be the
front runner?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you only know how to
chase!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way, of course not! ☆ Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: マヤノならなんだってできるよ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So that means you two can't look away
while I'm
running. Got it? ♪
